purpose: Editorial candidate inventory for the English dictionary expansion. This is an internal work file, not runtime dictionary content.
rules: Candidates are not approved dictionary entries until definition, part of speech, pronunciation, Simplified Chinese sense translation, and examples have been authored and reviewed.
Do not add a candidate if it is an inflectional variant better represented under an existing lemma.
A candidate may receive multiple reviewed categories during content authoring.
Prefer common and useful vocabulary; reject weak or low-value candidates rather than padding the target.
